title: Sulfurization and in-situ anneal of MoSe₂
summary: Convert FIB-irradiated MoSe₂ to MoS₂ by sulfurization, then purge the sulfur precursor and anneal in situ without sulfur gas. Written from the published sequence (Nano Lett. 2025, 25, 10123) and general tube-furnace practice; flows, pressures and ramp rates are blanks for the instrument owner to fill.

steps.title: Verify furnace, exhaust and gas supply
steps.body: Confirm that the furnace is idle and the connected carrier gas is the correct type (SOP: __ carrier gas). Verify that the exhaust/scrubber system is on and functioning before proceeding.
steps.caution: Sulfur vapour is toxic and flammable; confirm that the exhaust/scrubber is running before proceeding.

steps.title: Open the access covers
steps.body: Confirm that the tube is at room temperature before opening the access covers. Only open the covers once this condition is met.

steps.title: Position the sulfur precursor upstream
steps.body: Place the sulfur precursor in a boat (SOP: __ mg sulfur, __ cm upstream of the hot zone). Position the boat in the cooler inlet region of the tube, upstream of the sample.

steps.title: Load the sample at the hot-zone centre
steps.body: Load the FIB-irradiated MoSe₂ sample substrate face up in a clean boat at the centre of the furnace hot zone. Note its position for reproducibility.

steps.title: Close the covers and seal the flanges
steps.body: Confirm that the boats are positioned correctly and that tools are clear of the covers. Close the access covers and seal the flanges using the site SOP.
steps.caution: Check the flange O-rings and the quartz tube for damage before sealing.

steps.title: Purge with carrier gas
steps.body: Purge with carrier gas (SOP: __ sccm for __ min) until residual air is displaced. Check the pressure gauge against the approved operating pressure (SOP: __ [pressure units: __]) and confirm the carrier flow is at the set point before proceeding to heating.
steps.check: Flanges sealed, exhaust running, carrier flow at the set point

steps.title: Program the sulfurization segment
steps.body: Program a ramp (SOP: __ °C/min) to 700 °C and a hold of 10 min. Review the programmed segment before starting the run.

steps.title: Run the sulfurization
steps.body: Start the program to sulfurize the sample in a sulfur-rich ambient. Monitor the meters throughout the 700 °C / 10 min hold.
steps.caution: Do not open the shell while the furnace is running.

steps.title: Purge the sulfur precursor
steps.body: After the 700 °C hold ends, stop the sulfur supply or remove the precursor from the heated flow using the approved method (SOP: method __). Purge with carrier gas (SOP: __ sccm for __ min) until no sulfur gas remains before annealing. Annealing without sulfur gas prevents unintended doping of pristine (non-irradiated) regions of the sample.

steps.title: Anneal in situ at 900 °C
steps.body: Program a ramp (SOP: __ °C/min) to 900 °C and hold for 5 min. Run this annealing segment in situ without sulfur gas present, then end the program.

steps.title: Cool under carrier gas
steps.body: Keep carrier gas flowing until the tube is below the opening limit (SOP: __ C). Confirm that the sulfur line is closed before opening the covers.
steps.caution: The quartz tube and boats remain hot long after the display reading drops.
steps.check: Tube temperature is below the opening limit and the sulfur line is closed

steps.title: Open the covers and unload
steps.body: After confirming the opening limit and sulfur-line closure, open the access covers. Remove the boat containing the sample with tongs and place it on the designated heat-resistant surface.

steps.title: Close the covers
steps.body: Close the access covers with hands and tools clear, then continue to end of session.
